activities.name: Trevi Fountain+ Spanish steps
activities.vivid_description: The thunderous cascade of Trevi Fountain fills the air as you toss a coin over your shoulder, the baroque Neptune commanding his tritons amid the crystalline spray. Climbing the elegant travertine steps to Trinità dei Monti, the Spanish Steps unfold below you like a grand theater, with fashionable Romans and tourists creating a living tapestry against the honey-colored stone.

travel_leg.from_location: Camplus Guest Rome Casa per Ferie
travel_leg.tip: Take Metro A to Barberini station, then 5-minute walk downhill to the fountain

activities.name: Free time / shopping
activities.vivid_description: Via del Corso buzzes with the energy of Roman shoppers ducking into boutiques and gelaterias, while the narrow cobblestone streets around Pantheon reveal hidden artisan workshops where leather craftsmen tap rhythmically at their benches. The aroma of fresh espresso mingles with the scent of handmade soaps from local shops as you weave through the medieval alleyways.

travel_leg.tip: Head toward Via del Corso for major shopping or explore side streets for unique boutiques

activities.name: Pack & relax
activities.vivid_description: Back in your room, you fold clothes still carrying the faint scent of Roman stone dust and gelato, while the late afternoon sun streams through your window casting long shadows across your travel memories. The distant hum of Vespa engines and animated Italian conversations drift up from the street below as you prepare for departure.

travel_leg.tip: Take Metro A from Spagna to Termini, then Metro B to Ponte Mammolo for your accommodation
